input: Hem the curtains in the spare bedroom

keyUnknowns.whyItMatters: Knowing how many curtain panels need hemming determines the total work involved and whether the approach changes for multiple panels.
The amount to be taken up drives all measuring and cutting decisions — getting this wrong wastes fabric or leaves curtains still too long.
The hemming method (sewing machine, hand stitch, iron-on hem tape) affects the tools needed, finish quality, and time required.
Whether the curtains are already hung or removed affects the measuring approach and workspace setup.
Knowing the skill level of whoever is doing the hemming determines how detailed the instructions need to be and whether professional help is worth considering.
Whether a sewing machine, iron, or only basic hand tools are available directly determines which hemming method is viable.
The desired finish — a clean invisible hem vs. a visible decorative fold — changes the technique, thread choice, and acceptable margin of error.

gold.taskDescription: Shorten or finish the bottom edge of curtains hanging in the spare bedroom to achieve the desired length and appearance.

questions.title: How many curtain panels need to be hemmed?
questions.description: Establish the total number of individual panels to set the scope of the task.

questions.title: How much length needs to be removed from each panel?
questions.description: Determine the exact amount to take up so cutting and folding measurements can be set correctly.

questions.title: Which hemming method do you want to use — sewing, iron-on tape, or hand stitching?
questions.description: Identify the preferred technique to plan the right steps and materials.

questions.title: Are the curtains currently hung or already taken down?
questions.description: Knowing whether the panels are on the rail or removed affects how measuring and pinning will be done.

questions.title: How confident are you with basic sewing or fabric work?
questions.description: Gauge the skill level of the person doing the task to calibrate how much guidance is needed.

questions.title: What tools and equipment do you have available at home?
questions.description: Check availability of a sewing machine, iron, hem tape, pins, and measuring tape to confirm which methods are actually viable.

questions.title: Should the finished hem be invisible or is a visible fold acceptable?
questions.description: Define what a good result looks like so the right stitch type and fold style can be chosen.
